description: Index of DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles (Windows software analysis + a cross-platform Web-UI widget).

plugins.name: install-profiler
plugins.summary: Installer profiling, binary strings evidence, dynamic probe plan, snapshot diffing, reverse-engineering handoff.

plugins.name: reverse-skill
plugins.summary: Static-first reverse engineering across APK/JAR/native/.NET/Electron/firmware with an authorization gate.

plugins.name: relay-balance
plugins.summary: Draggable liquid-glass card and settings page showing a third-party relay's used/remaining balance plus the official DeepSeek account balance. Auto-detects sub2api (kakouai), new-api/one-api, OpenRouter and generic OpenAI-compatible sites; credentials stay on the host.
